title: Daily Website Backups
content:
## Daily Website Backups


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000030823


## Overview


We understand how important website backups are. That’s why every Brilliant Directories website comes with free 24-hour backups. But what if restoring the site to a previous version from more than 24 hours ago is needed?

This add-on provides peace of mind in knowing that there are 14 days worth of full, ready-to-use backups of the website.

```
How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: 14-Day Website Backups Add-On
```


## Requesting a Backup


When this add-on is added to the website, the daily backups is stored for up to 14 days back. If the admin wants for us to retrieve a site back up within the 14-day stored backups , all that is required is to submit a TICKET asking for this service. We will do this as soon as possible once we get the request.

When submitting the request, the following information is required:

- Website ID of the site to be restored

- The date to which the site would be restored. All backups are taken between 3am - 6am Eastern Time.
